summary: Windows 11 (build 26340), 1.0.71, COM3: read completed (power fix working) then decode failed: '`6532.8' is not a valid value for `ctone''. Stock BaofengCommonHT decodes any tone word >= 0x0258 as CTCSS value/10. Settings also logged 'Failed to load scode value 0: Value for 15 is out of range' (non-fatal). No .img attached.
title: Read decodes fail: invalid CTCSS word 6532.8 (rxtone 0xFF30)
